content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD boundary-condition and ghost-cell exchange source (Simplified BSD header L1-44). Four subroutines. (1) BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L53-295, history: Fengyan Shi 05/06/2010, Jeff Harris do-loop bug fix 04/05/2011 at L48-50): wall conditions on the four domain edges — on west (L61-98), east (L101-134), south (L143-177) and north (L179-208, closing PARALLEL/CARTESIAN guards to L212) edges it zeroes the normal flux (P or Q) and the cross flux (Gx or Fy) and sets the pressure part of the flux to the hydrostatic split form 0.5*GRAV*(Xi^2*Gamma3+2*Xi*Deps) using edge surface values EtaRxR/EtaRxL/EtaRyR/EtaRyL and Depthx/Depthy (e.g. L68-72). Preprocessor variants: PARALLEL guards apply only on MPI_PROC_NULL edges (L61-63 etc.), COUPLING restricts to segments outside the nested-input strip via Kstart_/Kend_ WEST/EAST/SOUTH/NORTH (L65-81,L105-121,L147-163,L180-198), CARTESIAN+PERIODIC skips the y-direction walls (L136-141,L210-212), and in the serial branch the west wall is skipped for WaveMaker 'ABS' or 'LEFT_BC_IRR' (L83-93). Then a masked-cell sweep over J=Jbeg-1..Jend+1, I=Ibeg-1..Iend+1 (L221-293): where MASK(I,J)<1 it zeroes P,Gx,Q,Fy on the four faces of the dry cell and rebuilds the pressure fluxes Fx(I,J), Fx(I+1,J), Gy(I,J), Gy(I,J+1) with the same split form times the neighbor MASK (L235,L252,L270,L287), with Jeff-reported parallel guards so interior processor edges are treated via n_west/n_east/n_suth/n_nrth checks (L226-230,L243-247,L261-265,L278-282); old HxL/HxR/HyL/HyR forms remain as comments (L231,L248,L266,L283). (2) EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L306-414): fills ghost cells of dispersion-related derivative arrays by repeated PHI_COLL calls with VTYPE codes (1=symmetric both directions, 2='like u', 3='like v') for Uxx,DUxx,Vyy,DVyy,Uxy,DUxy,Vxy,DVxy (L312-323 CARTESIAN with PERIODIC argument; L383-395 non-CARTESIAN), and when Gamma2>ZERO (L325) additionally ETAT,ETATx,ETATy if DISP_TIME_LEFT else Ut,Vt,Utx,Vty,Utxx,Vtyy,Utxy,Vtxy,DUtxx,DVtyy,DUtxy,DVtxy (L327-363), plus Ux,DUx,Vy,DVy,Uy,DUy,Vx,DVx,ETAx,ETAy (L365-379; non-CARTESIAN tail L397-411). (3) EXCHANGE (L426-529, ykchoi 08/19/2015 segfault fix noted L423,L449): ghost-cell collection for main state Eta,Wsurf,P_center,Q_center,U_davg,V_davg (VTYPE=1, L435-443), AGE_BREAKING if VISCOSITY_BREAKING (L445-447), nu_break if VISCOSITY_BREAKING.OR.WAVEMAKER_VIS (L450-452), face fluxes P,Q via PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH on Mloc1/Nloc1 grids if VISCOSITY_BREAKING.OR.DIFFUSION_SPONGE.OR.WAVEMAKER_VIS (L454-457), MASK roundtripped through real array rMASK for periodic exchange (L459-461), U,HU (VTYPE=2) and V,HV (VTYPE=3) (L463-468; non-CARTESIAN L470-485); then U,V,HU,HV multiplied by MASK (L491-494, with note that Eta*MASK is wrong L488-489); optional FILTERING block (L496-527): every filter_interval steps applies SHAPIRO_3 to Eta,U,V (L502-505), re-collects ghosts (L507-512), recomputes H=Eta*Gamma3+Depth (L514) and HU,HV=Max(H,MinDepthFrc)*U,V on wet cells (L516-523). (4) PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH (L539-617): mirror ghost fill for a PHI(Mloc,Nloc) array — west mirror skipped for ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR wavemakers (L558-566), east (L576-580), south (L592-596), north (L606-610), each inside PARALLEL MPI_PROC_NULL guards. (5) PHI_COLL (L631/633-1272): main ghost-cell collector; CARTESIAN version takes PERIODIC logical (L631,L657). Periodic y-exchange first (L668-746): with PARALLEL and PY>1 it exchanges Nghost-wide strips between the J=1 and J=PY processor rows per column II using send2d buffer, blocking MPI_SEND and MPI_IRECV+MPI_WAITALL (L672-721); with PY=1 it copies internally (L723-730); non-parallel copy at L735-740. Then per VTYPE: 1 eta-type mirror on all four sides (L753-844), 2 u-type with x-antisymmetric mirror PHI=-PHI on west/east (L847-937), 3 v-type with y-antisymmetric mirror on south/north (L939-1029), 4 cross-derivative type zeroing all four ghost strips (L1032-1108, y-side commented 'not an exact solution' L1070), 5 fully symmetric (L1111-1187), 6 fully anti-symmetric (L1190-1266). West-side mirrors for VTYPE 1,2,3 are skipped for ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR wavemakers (L763-771,L856-864,L949-957). COUPLING guards skip sides lying inside the nesting parent domain (IN_DOMAIN_*). Finally with PARALLEL, phi_exch(PHI) does the interprocessor exchange (L1268-1270).
entities: SUBROUTINE PHI_COLL @L631 (CARTESIAN signature with PERIODIC) / @L633 (non-CARTESIAN), END @L1272

verbatim_spans.text: ! Jeff pointed out the loop should be Jbeg-1, Jend+1
!   08/19/2015 Choi, corrected segmentation fault, maybe memory leaking
! etaR x mask is a wrong idea
! y-direction and corners, this one is not an exact solution
rMASK = MASK ! for periodic boundary condition

unresolved: Comment block L215-219 states the masked-cell loop was extended to Jbeg-1..Jend+1 per Jeff but that the routine still does not check whether a point adjacent to an inter-processor boundary (in ghost cells owned by another processor) is land — the code at L221-293 relies on exchanged MASK ghosts (EXCHANGE L459-461) and the flag guards L226-230 etc.; whether this fully resolves the described flux-modification problem is not decidable from this file

VTYPE=4 ghost treatment zeroes cross-derivative ghosts on y-sides with the in-code admission 'this one is not an exact solution' (L1070); no caller in this file uses VTYPE=4,5,6 — callers of PHI_COLL here use only VTYPE 1,2,3 (L312-511), so the users of types 4-6 are elsewhere

In BOUNDARY_CONDITION the serial (non-COUPLING) west branch skips the wall for WaveMaker ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR (L83-93) but the COUPLING west branch (L66-81) applies the wall unconditionally — cross-branch asymmetry between L66-81 and L83-93

PHI_COLL periodic MPI exchange (L676-721) uses blocking MPI_SEND before the matching MPI_IRECV is guaranteed posted (tag 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD); correctness relies on MPI buffering/ordering across the DO II=1,PX loop
Locals nreq,ll,l,JJ,myvar,mybeta declared @L661,L664 are never used in PHI_COLL
EXCHANGE converts integer MASK through REAL array rMASK for the periodic PHI_COLL call (L459-461); rounding behavior of the real-to-integer copy-back at L461 for exchanged ghost values is implicit
Fixed arrays EtaRxR/EtaRxL/EtaRyR/EtaRyL, Depthx/Depthy, Gamma3, Gamma2, MinDepthFrc, filter_interval, DISP_TIME_LEFT, IN_DOMAIN_*, Kstart_*/Kend_* come from GLOBAL/PARAM modules defined elsewhere
